verdict.rationale: SigNoz is open source and can be self-hosted on your own infrastructure with Docker, Kubernetes, or Linux. That keeps full control of the data plane and lets you decide where telemetry lives, and community users cite this self-hosting option as a draw. Nothing in the pack shows SigNoz Cloud letting you pick a region, so residency is achieved only by running and operating the stack yourself, which users describe as container-heavy. Missing for 10: documented SigNoz Cloud region selection or residency options, data-residency or compliance documentation, independent confirmation of residency control.
